messages:
deploy-bot: Starting multi-service rollout to staging · env=staging · tag=v2.14.0 · services=[runtime, api, console] · commits={runtime:3f9a1b2, api:8d4e7c1, console:2b7c9d0} :rocket:

alex: Quick Q — are we pinning the runtime model for this? last canary showed a small quality regression on v1.7

maria: yes, runtime will be pinned to model v1.6 for the rollout (per the perf/quality note in the release doc)

suresh: FYI the DB migration for analytics lands at 02:00 UTC, avoid full traffic shifts during that window

jen: Proposal: runtime/api 10% canary, console full deploy (console is safe). If canary looks good do staggered ramp. Agree?

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff · runtime=10% · api=10% · console=deploying (full) · started_by=@jen

release-bot: runtime.canary - instance runtime-canary-1 -> health=ok · p50=40ms p95=210ms · model=pinned-v1.6 :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: api.canary - deploying -> healthcheck failing on api-3 (502) · marking api.canary=degraded

alex: :eyes: Pulling logs from api-3 now

maria: snippet from proxy logs:
```
PROXY ERROR at /v1/generate -> upstream "api-3" responded 502
trace: Timeout while waiting for upstream response (handler: upstream/request)
```

alex: root cause looks like missing `X-User-Context` header in new layer. Reproducer locally -> 502 when header absent

suresh: rolling back api.canary to previous tag (8d1a) and enabling old header shim on ingress

deploy-bot: action: rollback api.canary -> target=8d1a · status=initiated

deploy-bot: api.canary rollback complete · api set to tag=8d1a on api-1,api-2,api-3 · health=ok :white_check_mark:

jen: Good catch. Putting full api rollout on hold until fix and a short regression test pass. Will schedule patch in next change window (in ~6h)

maria: created a tiny patch branch to add header shim + unit test, will run quick e2e after CI passes

alex: runtime and console are green on staging. console logs show no regressions. Runtime p95 stayed stable with pinned model v1.6

release-bot: console.deploy - success · console@2b7c9d0 · instances=3/3 · latency p95=85ms :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: runtime.rollout -> completed for staging · deployed tag=3f9a1b2 · model=pinned-v1.6 · canary->ramp->100%

jen: Summary from me: runtime ✅ (pinned to v1.6), console ✅, api ❌ (rollback to 8d1a). Overall: partial rollout. We will not promote v2.14.0 to prod for api until patch and short canary pass.

maria: I'll update the release notes: add "api reverted due to missing header shim; fix PR #4567 queued; next attempt in next change window"

deploy-bot: Final thread status · runtime=deployed(staging,v2.14.0,pinned-model:v1.6) · api=rolled-back(staging->8d1a) · console=deployed(staging,v2.14.0) · overall=partial · notes=api fix required

alex: thanks all — tagging ops for the scheduled change window: @sre-oncall please standby for patch rollout in ~6h

suresh: noted · I'll coordinate the change window and DB team so no conflict

jen: Follow-up actions: maria -> PR + e2e, alex -> validate ingress shim on staging, suresh -> reserve change window, jen -> schedule post-mortem if needed

deploy-bot: Thread closed for now · reopen when patch canary starts or if any regressions surface
